name: set_fabric_material
signature: set_fabric_material(fabric_index: int, face: int=0, material_type: int | None=None, metalness: float | None=None, roughness_type: int | None=None, roughness_intensity: int | None=None, roughness_map_intensity: int | None=None, roughness_map_invert: bool | None=None, reflection_intensity: float | None=None, reflection_roughness: float | None=None, normal_intensity: float | None=None, opacity_intensity: float | None=None, same_color_as_front: bool | None=None, same_material_as_front: bool | None=None, colorway_index: int | None=None) -> dict
description:
Set the render material of a fabric face. Only the given settings change.

Args:
    fabric_index: Fabric index.
    face: 0 front, 1 back, 2 side.
    material_type: CLO material type code.
    metalness: Metalness value.
    roughness_type: CLO roughness type code.
    roughness_intensity: Roughness intensity.
    roughness_map_intensity: Roughness map intensity.
    roughness_map_invert: Invert the roughness map.
    reflection_intensity: Reflection intensity.
    reflection_roughness: Reflection roughness.
    normal_intensity: Normal map intensity in percent.
    opacity_intensity: Opacity intensity in percent.
    same_color_as_front: Back or side uses the front color.
    same_material_as_front: Back or side uses the front material.
    colorway_index: Optional colorway.

name: set_fit_maps
signature: set_fit_maps(stress: bool | None=None, strain: bool | None=None) -> dict
description:
Show or hide the stress map and the strain map, to see where the garment is too tight.

Args:
    stress: True to show the stress map, False to hide it, None to leave it.
    strain: True to show the strain map, False to hide it, None to leave it.

name: set_grain_direction
signature: set_grain_direction(pattern_index: int, degrees: float) -> dict
description: Set the grain line direction of a pattern piece, in degrees (0 = vertical grain).

name: set_graphic_style
signature: set_graphic_style(style_index: int, name: str | None=None, width: float | None=None, height: float | None=None, only_this_side: bool=False, rgba: list[int] | None=None, colorway_index: int | None=None) -> dict
description:
Rename, resize or recolor a graphic style. Every graphic using the style follows.

Args:
    style_index: Zero-based graphic style index.
    name: Optional new name.
    width: Optional width in mm. With height, sets both.
    height: Optional height in mm.
    only_this_side: When only width or height is given, change that side alone instead of keeping the ratio.
    rgba: Optional base color, four integers 0-255.
    colorway_index: Optional colorway for the color.

name: set_graphic_style_maps
signature: set_graphic_style_maps(style_index: int, base_color: str | None=None, normal: str | None=None, displacement: str | None=None, opacity: str | None=None, roughness: str | None=None, metalness: str | None=None, colorway_index: int | None=None) -> dict
description:
Set texture maps of a graphic style, for example relief maps that make a logo look embroidered.

Args:
    style_index: Zero-based graphic style index.
    base_color: Optional absolute image path for the color map.
    normal: Optional normal map.
    displacement: Optional displacement map.
    opacity: Optional opacity map.
    roughness: Optional roughness map.
    metalness: Optional metalness map.
    colorway_index: Optional colorway for the color map.

name: set_mesh_type
signature: set_mesh_type(pattern_index: int, mesh_type: str) -> dict
description: Set the mesh type of a pattern piece and return its face and vertex counts.

name: set_nesting_pattern
signature: set_nesting_pattern(pattern_index: int, x: int | None=None, y: int | None=None, grain_mode: int | None=None) -> dict
description: Fix a piece at (x, y) in the layout, or set how it may turn: 0 one way, 1 two ways, 2 four ways.

name: set_particle_distance
signature: set_particle_distance(pattern_index: int, distance: float) -> dict
description: Set the simulation mesh size of a pattern piece in mm. Smaller is finer and slower (default 20).

name: set_particle_distance_all
signature: set_particle_distance_all(distance: float) -> dict
description: Set the simulation mesh size of every pattern piece, in mm (default 20).

name: set_pattern_category
signature: set_pattern_category(pattern_index: int, category: int | None=None, classification: str | None=None) -> dict
description: Set the category number or the classification text of a pattern piece (front, sleeve, collar...).

name: set_pattern_fabric
signature: set_pattern_fabric(pattern_index: int, fabric_index: int) -> dict
description: Use a fabric for a pattern piece.

name: set_pattern_name
signature: set_pattern_name(pattern_index: int, name: str) -> dict
description:
Rename a pattern piece.

Args:
    pattern_index: Zero-based index of the pattern piece.
    name: New name for the pattern piece.

name: set_pattern_position
signature: set_pattern_position(pattern_index: int, x: float, y: float) -> dict
description: Move a pattern piece in the 2D window to (x, y), in mm.

name: set_pattern_state
signature: set_pattern_state(pattern_index: int, layer: int | None=None, freeze: bool | None=None, lock: bool | None=None, hide_3d: bool | None=None, solidify: bool | None=None, solidify_strength: float | None=None, strengthen: bool | None=None, grain_link_all_colorways: bool | None=None) -> dict
description:
Set the simulation state of a pattern piece. Only the given settings change.

Args:
    pattern_index: Zero-based pattern index.
    layer: Layer number, higher layers go over lower ones (a jacket over a shirt).
    freeze: Freeze the piece in place.
    lock: Lock the piece against edits.
    hide_3d: Hide the piece in the 3D window.
    solidify: Make the piece rigid, as for a collar or a cuff.
    solidify_strength: Rigidity strength.
    strengthen: Reinforce the piece.
    grain_link_all_colorways: Share the grain direction across colorways.

name: set_schematic
signature: set_schematic(render: bool | None=None, seam_lines: bool | None=None, internal_lines: bool | None=None, topstitch_lines: bool | None=None, silhouette: bool | None=None, seam_line_width: int | None=None, internal_line_width: int | None=None, silhouette_width: int | None=None, topstitch_scale_percent: int | None=None) -> dict
description: Show the garment as a flat technical drawing and choose which lines appear and how thick.

name: set_seam_taping
signature: set_seam_taping(pattern_index: int, line_index: int=-1, enabled: bool=True, width: float | None=None) -> dict
description: Put a seam tape along a line of a pattern piece (-1 for all lines), with an optional width in mm.

name: set_shirring
signature: set_shirring(pattern_index: int, line_index: int=-1, enabled: bool=True, height: float | None=None, interval: float | None=None, extend: bool | None=None) -> dict
description:
Turn gathers (shirring) on or off along a line of a pattern piece.

Args:
    pattern_index: Zero-based pattern index.
    line_index: Zero-based line index, -1 for all lines.
    enabled: True to gather.
    height: Optional shirring height in mm.
    interval: Optional shirring interval in mm.
    extend: Optional, extend the shirring.

name: set_shrinkage
signature: set_shrinkage(pattern_index: int, width_percent: float | None=None, height_percent: float | None=None) -> dict
description: Set the fabric shrinkage of a pattern piece in percent, across and along the grain.

name: set_simulation_quality
signature: set_simulation_quality(quality: int, simulation_mode: int=0) -> dict
description:
Set the simulation preset.

Args:
    quality: 0 normal, 1 animation (stable), 2 fitting (accurate fabric), 3 fast (GPU).
    simulation_mode: 0 CPU, 1 fast (GPU).

name: set_simulation_settings
signature: set_simulation_settings(time_step: float | None=None, substeps: int | None=None, cg_iterations: int | None=None, cg_residual: float | None=None, cg_finish_condition: int | None=None, self_collision_iterations: int | None=None, self_collision_stiffness: float | None=None, layer_based_collision: bool | None=None, nonlinear: bool | None=None, air_damping: float | None=None, gravity: float | None=None, ground_collision: bool | None=None, ground_height: float | None=None, cpu_count: int | None=None) -> dict
description:
Advanced simulation settings. Only the given settings change.

Args:
    time_step: Seconds per step (default 0.0333, min 0.001).
    substeps: Substeps per step (1 to 50).
    cg_iterations: Solver iterations per step (1 to 1000, default 50).
    cg_residual: Solver residual to stop (0.0001 normal, 0.00001 animation and fitting).
    cg_finish_condition: 0 by iterations, 1 by residual.
    self_collision_iterations: Self-collision iterations (default 1).
    self_collision_stiffness: Self-collision avoidance stiffness (default 0.001).
    layer_based_collision: Use pattern layers for collisions.
    nonlinear: Nonlinear simulation.
    air_damping: Air damping (default 1.0).
    gravity: Gravity on y in mm per second squared (default -9800).
    ground_collision: Collide with the ground.
    ground_height: Ground height on y.
    cpu_count: Number of CPU threads.

name: set_substance
signature: set_substance(fabric_index: int, face: int=0, preset_index: int | None=None, resolution_index: int | None=None, colorway_index: int | None=None) -> dict
description: Choose the preset or the resolution of the Substance material of a fabric.

name: set_texture_mapping
signature: set_texture_mapping(fabric_index: int, mapping_type: int, colorway_index: int | None=None) -> dict
description: Set how the fabric texture is mapped: repeat or unified (CLO type code).

name: set_topstitch
signature: set_topstitch(pattern_index: int, stitch_index: int, style_index: int | None=None, curved: bool | None=None, curved_length: int | None=None, right_angled: bool | None=None, extend_start: bool | None=None, extend_end: bool | None=None, z_offset: float | None=None) -> dict
description: Change a topstitch already placed on a pattern piece. Only the given settings change.

name: set_topstitch_style
signature: set_topstitch_style(style_index: int, name: str | None=None, number_of_lines: int | None=None, distance: float | None=None, width: float | None=None, offset_index: int | None=None, line_index: int=1) -> dict
description:
Change a topstitch style: name, number of rows, distance between rows, thread width, offset.
line_index is the stitch row, starting at 1.

name: set_topstitch_style_color
signature: set_topstitch_style_color(style_index: int, line_index: int=-1, rgba: list[int] | None=None, opacity: int | None=None, colorway_index: int | None=None) -> dict
description:
Set the thread color or opacity of a topstitch style.

Args:
    style_index: Topstitch style index.
    line_index: Stitch row of the style, -1 for all rows.
    rgba: Optional color, four integers 0-255.
    opacity: Optional opacity value.
    colorway_index: Optional colorway.

name: set_trim_material
signature: set_trim_material(style_index: int, properties: dict[str, str], mesh_index: int=0) -> dict
description: Change material properties of a trim style mesh. Read get_trim_material first to know the keys.

name: set_trim_style
signature: set_trim_style(style_index: int, rgba: list[int] | None=None, mesh_index: int=-1, weight: float | None=None, colorway_index: int | None=None) -> dict
description: Set the color (four integers 0-255, mesh -1 for all) or the weight of a trim style.

name: set_zipper_style
signature: set_zipper_style(style_index: int, name: str | None=None, teeth_type: int | None=None, teeth_width: float | None=None, tape_thickness: float | None=None, weight: float | None=None, slider: str | None=None, puller: str | None=None, top_stopper: str | None=None, bottom_stopper: str | None=None) -> dict
description: Change a zipper style: name, teeth, tape thickness, weight, slider, puller and stoppers.

name: sew_lines
signature: sew_lines(pattern_a: int, line_a: int, pattern_b: int, line_b: int, direction_a: bool=True, direction_b: bool=True, child_a: int | None=None, child_b: int | None=None) -> dict
description:
Sew two lines together: outline to outline, outline to an internal shape, or internal to internal.

Use child_b to sew an outline line of piece A onto a line of an internal shape of piece B, for example
a patch sewn on a garment at the exact place of an internal shape.

Args:
    pattern_a: Zero-based index of the first pattern piece.
    line_a: Line index on the first piece, or on its internal shape child_a.
    pattern_b: Zero-based index of the second pattern piece.
    line_b: Line index on the second piece, or on its internal shape child_b.
    direction_a: Sewing direction along line_a (True: forward).
    direction_b: Sewing direction along line_b. Flip it if the seam comes out twisted.
    child_a: Optional internal shape index on piece A (from create_internal_shape).
    child_b: Optional internal shape index on piece B (from create_internal_shape).

name: show_hide_avatar
signature: show_hide_avatar(show: bool=True) -> dict
description: Show or hide the avatar in the 3D window.

name: simulate
signature: simulate(steps: int=100) -> dict
description:
Run cloth simulation for a number of steps.

Args:
    steps: Number of simulation steps to run (default 100).

name: start_nesting
signature: start_nesting(buffer_spacing: float | None=None, target_colorways: list[int] | None=None) -> dict
description:
Start the automatic layout of the pieces on the fabric width, to measure fabric consumption.

Args:
    buffer_spacing: Optional gap between pieces in mm.
    target_colorways: Optional colorways that receive the layout.

name: stop_nesting
signature: stop_nesting() -> dict
description: Stop the automatic layout.

name: symmetry_pattern
signature: symmetry_pattern(pattern_index: int | None=None, name: str | None=None, flag: bool=True) -> dict
description:
Create the symmetric piece of a pattern piece, for example the left sleeve from the right one.

Args:
    pattern_index: Zero-based pattern index, or give name.
    name: Pattern name.
    flag: Option of CLO's symmetry command, probably keeping the two pieces linked.

name: unfold_pattern
signature: unfold_pattern(pattern_index: int, line_index: int, half_symmetry: bool=False) -> dict
description:
Unfold a half pattern piece along one of its lines, as for a piece cut on the fold.

Args:
    pattern_index: Zero-based pattern index.
    line_index: Line used as the fold.
    half_symmetry: Keep the two halves linked so edits are mirrored.

name: unfold_pattern_by_name
signature: unfold_pattern_by_name(name: str, line_index: int, half_symmetry: bool=False) -> dict
description: Unfold a half pattern piece, found by its name, along one of its lines.

name: update_colorways
signature: update_colorways(update_snapshot: bool=True) -> dict
description: Refresh the colorways, and their snapshots if asked.
